name: Home Greeting: cohort dpp date 3 days ago shows Week 1
statusMessage: Skipped: Blocked: setting the cohort's dpp_start_date goes through the admin portal's Edit Cohort form (updateCohortDppDate in utils/helpers.py), which authenticates with a hardcoded admin session cookie + CSRF token in payloads/requests/AdminPortal/updateUserCohortProgDate.py. That session has expired, so the PATCH is redirected to the login page and the date never changes. Re-enable once updateCohortDppDate logs into the admin portal itself each run (POST /sessions with creds from secrets, then GET the cohort edit page for a fresh CSRF token), or once the backend offers a token-based API to set a cohort's start date.
